study_type: exploratory task expansion; not independent confirmation
selection: Within each run select earliest minimum validation loss/MSE; across learning rates select minimum validation score, ties by smaller LR then earlier epoch. Test metrics never enter selection.
failure_policy: All failures retained. Primary complete-horizon summary and sensitivity using best finite validation checkpoint from stopped trials are both reported; no broad win if the latter overturns the comparison.
negative_results: Main text may focus on supported positive results; full comparison tables and records retain every task and method. No test-based deletion.
matrix_completion: 50% train, 10% validation, 40% test entries, disjoint fixed masks. Validation selection uses only validation entries; planted full-matrix error is a separate diagnostic.
momentum: PyTorch SGD-M uses unnormalized momentum; quotient/balance use EMA as in current proposal. All arms receive the same 9-LR budget, extended through 0.1 to examine underfitting.
test_access: No per-epoch test evaluations; test metrics evaluated after validation selection and at final horizon only.
horizons: Original full proposal 1000/2000 epochs, seed 42. No shortened formal results.
